links.content: Our offer contains links to external third-party websites, on whose contents we have no influence. Therefore, we cannot assume any liability for these external contents. The respective provider or operator of the pages is always responsible for the contents of the linked pages.

copyright.title: Copyright

overview.title: 1. Privacy at a glance
overview.content: The following information provides a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data that can be used to identify you personally.

server.title: Server log files
server.content: The provider of the pages automatically collects and stores information in so-called server log files, which your browser automatically transmits to us. These are: browser type and browser version, operating system used, referrer URL, hostname of the accessing computer, time of the server request and IP address. This data is not merged with other data sources. See the „Hosting with IONOS SE“ section for details on processing by our host.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.content: This website does not use tracking, analytics, or advertising cookies. Only technically necessary data is used: your language preference is stored via a cookie (NEXT_LOCALE), and your theme preference (light/dark) is stored in your browser's local storage (localStorage). Both serve solely to display the website according to your settings and are not evaluated for analytics or advertising purposes. No separate consent is required for these purely technical purposes (§ 25 para. 2 TTDSG, Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR).

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you contact us by email, your information including the contact details you provide there will be stored with us for the purpose of processing the request and in the event of follow-up questions. We do not pass on this data without your consent. The legal basis is Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b or lit. f GDPR.

account.title: Registration and customer account
account.content: If you register for the OpenEOS platform or create an organization, we collect and store the account data required to perform the contract (e.g. name, email address, and organization details). Processing is carried out to fulfil the usage agreement pursuant to Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR and is not shared with third parties beyond what is necessary for contract fulfilment.

hosting.title: 4. Hosting with IONOS SE
hosting.content: This website is hosted by IONOS SE, Elgendorfer Str. 57, 56410 Montabaur, Germany. When you access the website, our host automatically collects and stores server logfiles transmitted by your browser (including IP address, date and time of the request, page requested, browser type and version). We have a data processing agreement with IONOS pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR, which obliges IONOS to process the data of our website visitors solely on our instructions and for the contractually agreed purposes, and to protect it appropriately.

appHosting.title: 5. Hosting of the application (app.openeos.de)
appHosting.content: The OpenEOS application and its databases are operated at Hetzner Online GmbH (Industriestr. 25, 91710 Gunzenhausen, Germany) in German data centers. We have a data processing agreement with Hetzner pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR.

paymentProviders.title: 6. Payment service providers
paymentProviders.content: To process payments, our customers (organizers) use the following providers depending on their configuration: SumUp (SumUp Payments Limited, Ireland), Stripe (Stripe Payments Europe Ltd., Ireland) and PayPal (PayPal (Europe) S.à r.l. et Cie, S.C.A., Luxembourg). The data required for payment processing is transmitted to the respective provider; their respective privacy policies apply.

fiscalization.title: 7. Fiscalization (technical security system)
fiscalization.content: To comply with the German Cash Security Ordinance (KassenSichV), receipt data (amount, tax rate, payment method, time) is transmitted to the cloud TSE of fiskaly GmbH (Zollhof 8, 90443 Nuremberg) for signing. No names or other personal data of buyers is transmitted. We have a data processing agreement with fiskaly pursuant to Art. 28 GDPR.

emailService.title: 8. Email delivery
emailService.content: Transactional emails (e.g. registration, receipts) are sent via our SMTP provider. Your email address is processed for this purpose.

support.title: 9. Support via Telegram
support.content: Our support can be contacted voluntarily via Telegram. Content and metadata accrue at Telegram; Telegram's privacy policy applies.

ssl.title: 10. SSL/TLS encryption
ssl.content: For security reasons and to protect the transmission of confidential content, such as requests you send to us as the site operator, this website uses SSL/TLS encryption. You can recognize an encrypted connection by the fact that the address line of your browser changes from „http://“ to „https://“ and by the lock icon in your browser's address bar.

storage.title: 11. Storage duration
storage.content: Unless a more specific storage period is stated within this privacy policy, your personal data will remain with us until the purpose for the data processing no longer applies. We delete contact inquiries once they have been fully processed, provided no statutory retention obligations apply. Data from a customer account is stored for the duration of the contractual relationship and beyond, in accordance with commercial and tax law retention periods (generally 6 or 10 years).

rights.title: 12. Your rights
rights.content:
You always have the right to:
• Receive information about your data stored by us
• Have this data corrected or deleted
• Restrict processing
• Object to processing
• Receive your data in a transferable format
• File a complaint with a supervisory authority

changes.title: 13. Changes
changes.content: We reserve the right to adapt this privacy policy so that it always complies with current legal requirements or to implement changes to our services in the privacy policy. The new privacy policy will then apply to your next visit.

scope.title: 1. Scope
scope.content: These General Terms and Conditions (T&C) apply to all contracts between OpenEOS (hereinafter "Provider") and the customer regarding the use of the OpenEOS Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform and related services.

services.title: 2. Description of services
services.content:
The provider offers the customer a web-based POS solution. The services include:
• Access to the OpenEOS platform
• Hosting and maintenance of the infrastructure
• Regular updates and security patches
• Support via email, phone and WhatsApp (with SaaS plans)
• Data backup

registration.title: 3. Registration and conclusion of contract
registration.content: Registration takes place by creating an organization on the platform. Upon completion of registration, a contract is concluded between the customer and the provider. The customer assures that all information provided is correct and complete.

pricing.title: 4. Prices and tariffs
pricing.content:
The prices displayed on the website at the time of booking apply:
• SaaS: €25 per event day
• Starter bonus: 20% discount on the first event days (new customers)
• Hardware rental: €50 per device per day

All prices include statutory value added tax.

payment.title: 5. Payment
payment.content: Billing is based on actual usage and invoiced. Event days are aggregated at the end of the month and invoiced. Payment terms: 14 days net.

obligations.title: 6. Customer obligations
obligations.content:
The customer undertakes to:
• Treat access data confidentially
• Not use the platform abusively
• Not process illegal content
• Comply with applicable data protection regulations
• Ensure the correctness of the data entered

liability.title: 7. Liability
liability.content: The provider is liable without limitation for damages resulting from injury to life, body or health as well as for intentionally or grossly negligently caused damages. Otherwise, liability is limited to foreseeable, contract-typical damages. Liability for lost profits, indirect damages or data loss is excluded to the extent permitted by law.

termination.title: 8. Contract term and termination
termination.content: The contract is concluded for an indefinite period. Both parties may terminate the contract at any time with a notice period of 14 days to the end of the month. The right to extraordinary termination for good cause remains unaffected.

changes.title: 9. Changes to the T&C
changes.content: The provider reserves the right to change these T&C. Changes will be communicated to the customer at least 30 days before they take effect. If the customer does not object within 14 days of receipt of the notification, the changed T&C shall be deemed accepted.

jurisdiction.title: 10. Final provisions
jurisdiction.content: The law of the Federal Republic of Germany shall apply to the exclusion of the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods. The place of jurisdiction for all disputes arising from this contract is, to the extent permitted by law, the registered office of the provider. Should individual provisions of these T&C be invalid, the validity of the remaining provisions shall remain unaffected.
